You have scenes in this that clearly aren’t Bermuda ! Within 4 minutes there are scenes of trees at fall which appear to be in the USA ! This type of scene is repeated later. Houses with tin roofs which appear to be from the Caribbean or similar and certainly aren’t in Bermuda. 

Office clothing of traditional jacket shorts and socks haven’t been standards wear for years. Prevalent in the 80’s and 90’s but not now. A much more informal wear is the common attire !
